module_summary: CDMA descriptor multiplexer: a round-robin arbiter grants one of PORTS descriptor inputs, a grant-indexed mux feeds a skid-buffered output register with port index appended to the tag, and status is demuxed back by tag bits.

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_valid
anchors.why: Per-port descriptor valid; forms arbiter requests

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_ready
anchors.why: Ready returned only to granted port when output can accept

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_read_addr
anchors.why: Packed per-port read address descriptors selected by grant

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_len
anchors.why: Packed per-port transfer lengths selected by grant

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector: valid ports not currently granted

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Releases arbiter grant on descriptor handshake

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded winning port; selects input descriptor fields and tag prefix

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter has a grant; gates ready and internal valid

anchors.name: current_s_desc_read_addr
anchors.why: Grant-selected descriptor fields from muxed input port

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_tag_int
anchors.why: Output tag: grant index concatenated with port tag for routing

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_valid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid into skid buffer from selected port

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_ready_int_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer input ready; gates input accept and store paths

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_read_addr_reg
anchors.why: Output register stage for descriptor fields

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_valid_reg
anchors.why: Output register valid driving m_axis_desc_valid

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_desc_read_addr_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register holding descriptor when output stalls

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_desc_valid_reg
anchors.why: Temp skid register occupied; affects ready and output reload

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads output registers from muxed input

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads temp skid registers when output stalled

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp registers into output when downstream ready

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_valid
anchors.why: Descriptor valid to CDMA core

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_ready
anchors.why: CDMA core accepts descriptor; drives skid buffer moves

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_read_addr
anchors.why: Descriptor read address to CDMA core

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_tag
anchors.why: Descriptor tag with port index for status routing

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: Status valid from CDMA core, demuxed to port by tag

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_status_tag
anchors.why: Status tag; upper bits select destination port

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_status_valid_reg
anchors.why: Per-port status valid one-hot from tag port bits

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_status_tag_reg
anchors.why: Registered status tag broadcast to all ports

groups.name: Port arbiter
groups.description: Round-robin arbiter selecting one descriptor input port

groups.name: Descriptor input mux
groups.description: Selects granted port descriptor fields, prefixes port index to tag

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer driving descriptor output to CDMA

groups.name: Status demux
groups.description: Routes CDMA status back to originating port by tag bits
